name: manual_4b4e74
claim: When a security/consensus module reports 'implemented and tested' with N passing unit tests, grep for its real call sites across src/ and orchestrator/ (excluding tests/) before trusting the docstring's production-status claim — a fully-tested module can still have zero production callers, meaning all the hardening work delivers zero live risk reduction until wiring lands.

decisions.notes: StateTransitionManager.evaluate_observation() in orchestrator/state_transition_manager.py had 35/35 passing tests and a docstring calling it the live 'Phase 1b Security Decision Pipeline', but grep confirmed zero callers outside tests/ (2026-07-12, PR #205 quad-CEO-review, independently re-verified 4+ times by different reviewers). PATTERN-SYNTHESIS.md gate now requires wiring proof before further P5/P6/P13 hardening.
